business_problem: As access to generative AI expands, companies have the potential to use the technology to improve people’s lives. Chilean media holding company Megamedia chose to use generative AI to make it simpler for people to find information about government support programs.
solution_summary: As access to generative AI expands, companies have the potential to use the technology to improve people’s lives. Chilean media holding company Megamedia chose to use generative AI to make it simpler for people to find information about government support programs. Because it is powered by large language models (LLMs), interacting with the Dato Útil chatbot feels like a real conversation, a much better user experience than chatbots with only static, preloaded answers. The chatbot is built using Claude 2, an LLM from Anthropic, through Amazon Bedrock , a fully managed service that offers a choice of high-performing foundation models from well-known AI companies. ARKHO provided expertise in Amazon Bedrock, which is integrated within Generative AI Application Builder on AWS. “We use Amazon Bedrock for basically all our generative AI use cases because it is very flexible,” says Nicolas Caraball, data scientist at ARKHO.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Hosts the foundation models and generative AI application logic.
